content.comment_body: Hello. Why does data entered in the weekly timer block using the web editor not remain persistent after a power outage?
Without seeing your [product_name] program, it's difficult to assist. Is the program stored only in the device's memory, or is it also written to an SD card?

Greetings. The [product_name] Soft Comfort program is stored on an SD card, which must be selected from an icon in the INTERFACE menu before transferring the program from the PC to the device. Here is a link with details on the problem: [url]
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note this is an English-language forum. Kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you.

Hello [user_name], apologies, but your screenshot and video aren't useful since the text is in Spanish. Most members of this forum do not speak Spanish. Please upload your [product_name] Soft Comfort program and the web editor project in a Zip file and describe your issue in English. Thank you.

Greetings. Here is a screenshot of the [product_name] Soft Comfort program and the described issue. The program is saved on a micro SD card placed in the appropriate slot of the device. I set this up by marking the relevant field in the software. Program saved on micro SD.
Greetings. Here is a screenshot of the web editor program and the issue as explained.
I requested that you upload the actual program files, not screenshots. Screenshots are not sufficient.

If you saved the [product_name] Soft Comfort program on the SD card, that's likely the source of the issue. Values changed via the web server are only updated in the device's memory, not on the SD card. After a power outage, the system checks for a program on the SD card and reloads it, restoring the original program data and losing web server changes. Do you need to save the program on the SD card?

Apologies. I understood your message from 2/19/2023 4:10 AM. The issue was saving the program on the micro SD card. When the [product_name] Soft Comfort program is stored in the device memory instead, the problem is resolved. That solves the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user discovered that changes made to a weekly timer through the web editor are lost after a power outage if the program is stored on a micro SD card. This occurs because, at restart, the device reloads parameters from the SD card, replacing any web editor adjustments made during operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated that any changes input via the web editor for the weekly timer block would remain intact after a power loss or restart, regardless of whether the program was stored internally or on a memory card.
